ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: preference_pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted
ir.intuition: Repaired to reduce similarity by replacing the hinge loss with a log-sigmoid loss that softly penalizes incorrect ranking. The weighting by the absolute advantage gap remains to prioritize pairs with stronger preference differences, but hinge and margin are removed to avoid the previous loss being too similar. This continuous smooth loss encourages the model to assign higher log probabilities to preferred sequences relative to the less preferred ones, maintaining a nonnegative loss and improving training stability.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weighting = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    base_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(diff))
    loss = ops.mul(base_loss, weighting)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
